name: pipaya-extension-voice-input
description: [Superseded] Built into pipaya 0.8.0+; use Settings > Voice input and turn this extension off. Adds a microphone button in the composer to dictate through an OpenAI-compatible transcription API.
author: dohwi

descriptions.en: [Superseded] Built into pipaya 0.8.0+; use Settings > Voice input and turn this extension off. Adds a microphone button to the composer.
descriptions.ko: [대체됨] pipaya 0.8.0부터 음성 입력이 앱에 내장되었습니다. 설정 > 음성 입력을 쓰고 이 확장은 끄세요. 입력창에 마이크 버튼을 추가합니다.
